_purpose: Meta descriptions for guides whose summary falls outside 110-160 characters. The guide records in data/authority/content_registry.json are hash-frozen, so the search-result text lives here instead; lib/seo.ts guideMetaDescription() reads this first, then the summary when it already fits. scripts/validators/validate_rendered_seo_contract.mjs fails the build on any rendered description outside 110-160.

descriptions.bridal-shower-checklist: A bridal shower is somebody else's hosted event, so settle who decides and who pays first, then the guest list, the date, and the party itself.
descriptions.day-of-coordinator-checklist: A day-of coordinator can only run what they were handed: the timeline, vendor sheet, contracts, payments, and a list of decisions they may make alone.
descriptions.elopement-planning-checklist: An elopement drops guests but not legal rules: check the licence, waiting period, witnesses, officiant authority, and location permits before travel.
descriptions.wedding-emergency-kit: Pack a wedding emergency kit by failure mode (garment, body, paper, power, weather) in two bags, one for getting ready and one for the venue.
descriptions.wedding-budget-template: A wedding budget template needs six columns per line: estimate, quote, contracted, paid, balance, and the month the balance falls due.
descriptions.wedding-day-timeline-template: A wedding day timeline template where every row has a duration, an owner, and a location, so it can be cut into versions for each vendor and role.
descriptions.wedding-rehearsal-timeline: Run a wedding rehearsal in under an hour: processional in reverse, positions before movement, the full sequence twice, then readings and handoffs.
